_comment: Vendor search regex for the English client. The first matching rule is used. build: regex on the build planner name (or file name) linked to the character, classes: fallback by class when no build is linked, acts: empty = every act. Same rules as regex_ko.json.

rules.name: Navira

rules._note: Original from the guide (English client): movement speed, projectile skill levels, spirit, amulets, rings, spears

rules.name: Grenade starter
rules._note: Korean rule: not a quiver, and crossbow / movement speed / added damage to attacks

rules.name: Shield Smith
rules._note: Original from the guide (English client): added damage to attacks, speed, melee, leech, tower shields

_vendors_comment: When one of these NPCs speaks in town (shop greeting), the regex is copied to the clipboard. English names of the vendors in regex_ko.json.
